subject: Activation scope alignment: Zenith Therapeutics — Go-live planning
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zenith Therapeutics — sales -> CS handoff: activation scope & timeline

Mina,

Quick handoff for Zenith (they signed last week). High level: 6-month contract, paid annually, $120k ARR. Go-live target: internal target = 2027-08-15, customer prefers 2027-08-10. Implementation scope: API integration for document ingestion (S3), embeddings-based search, and a custom reranking endpoint.

Key contacts:
- Alicia Stone, Sr. PM (implementation lead) — alicia.stone@zenithtx.com
- Markus Dean, IT Ops (infra & access) — markus.dean@zenithtx.com

Known open items (sales notes):
1) Customer requires SOC2 evidence and an on-prem proxy option discussion (they flagged for compliance).
2) They requested support for a strict data retention policy (30 days) — legal will review SOW but we should surface config options.
3) Need to confirm whether they require dedicated capacity (they asked about Dedicated pricing).

Attachments I pushed to the deal record: Zenith_SOW_v3.pdf (redlines from legal), initial deployment schedule (spreadsheet). I also included a proposed runbook in the HubSpot attachments.

Asks for CS:
- Confirm owner for kickoff and technical intake by EOD Friday 7/2.
- Suggest initial kickoff agenda and intake checklist (network, service accounts, sample data).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

Karthik
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0192

Pre-kickoff asks for customer intake (please share with Alicia/Markus during intro):
- Preferred kickoff dates/times in early August (we can do 8/2, 8/3, 8/9 or 8/10; internal preference is week of 8/9 to give engineering time).
- List of sample documents to ingest and expected daily volume (rough estimate).
- S3 bucket details or alternative transfer method; will need an IAM role or temporary creds.
- IP ranges for their network if they plan to whitelist Redwood endpoints.

I'll attach a lightweight kickoff agenda and an intake checklist — sending as stub attachments here (attachment: cs_kickoff_agenda_v1.docx; attachment: intake_checklist.csv). Also adding a suggested 90-day success plan.

Thanks Karthik — and hi Tessa / Mina. Great to meet you.

We can do the kickoff on Tuesday 2027-08-10 at 10:00am PT — that works best for our team. I’ll share a small anonymized sample dataset by Monday 7/5 and Markus will own IAM provisioning (I’ve looped him in).

A few notes up front:
- SOC2 evidence: our compliance team will want the standard artifacts; if you can share the SOC2 scope summary before the kickoff that would help.
- Retention: 30 days is non-negotiable for the initial phase; we understand there may be configuration work.
- Dedicated capacity: we’re open to your recommendation but want a clear cost/latency tradeoff in writing before signing any Dedicated add-on.

Looking forward to the kickoff.
